mapper.update: update bm_procedure_step_model set is_deleted = 1, del_id_flag = id where procedure_model_id = #{procedureModelId}
mapper.select:
select t1.id, t1.record_item_id, t1.record_version_id, t1.create_time, t1.reusable, t1.name as procedureStepName, t1.procedure_step_id, t2.name as procedureName, t3.name as recordItemName, t1.procedure_step_id from bm_procedure_step_model t1 join bm_procedure_model t2 on t1.procedure_model_id = t2.id and t2.is_deleted = false join bm_batch_record_item t3 on t1.record_item_id = t3.item_id and t1.record_version_id = t3.record_version_id and t3.is_deleted = false where t1.is_deleted = false and t1.process_id = #{processId} and t1.process_version = #{processVersion}
and t1.node_function != #{nodeFunction}

select t1.id, t1.name, t1.procedure_step_id, t1.procedure_id, t1.procedure_model_id, t1.reusable, t1.record_item_id, t1.record_version_id, t2.name as procedureName from bm_procedure_step_model t1 join bm_procedure_model t2 on t1.procedure_model_id = t2.id and t2.is_deleted = false where t1.is_deleted = false and t1.process_id = #{processId} and t1.process_version = #{processVersion}

select distinct t1.procedure_step_id, t1.reusable as reuse, t1.record_item_id, t1.record_version_id, t2.component_type, t2.field_id from bm_procedure_step_model t1 join bm_batch_record_component t2 on t1.record_item_id = t2.record_item_id and t1.record_version_id = t2.record_version_id and t2.is_deleted = 0 where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.process_id = #{query.processId} and t1.process_version = #{query.processVersion} and t2.field_id in
#{item}

select t1.name as recordName, t1.id as id, t1.item_id as record_item_id, t1.item_type, t1.page_config, t1.record_version_id, t2.procedure_step_id, t2.id as copyVersionId, t2.version as copy_version, t2.is_reuse as reuse, t2.is_discard as discard, t2.process_change_number, t2.procedure_change_number, t3.procedure_model_id, t3.procedure_id, t3.id as procedureStepModelId from bm_execute_record_copy t2 left join bm_procedure_step_model t3 on t3.process_id = #{processId} and t3.process_version = #{processVersion} and t3.is_deleted = 0 AND ((t2.is_reuse = false AND t3.procedure_step_id = t2.procedure_step_id) OR (t2.is_reuse = true AND t3.reusable = t2.is_reuse)) and t3.record_item_id = t2.record_item_id and t3.record_version_id = t2.record_version_id join bm_batch_record_item t1 on t2.record_item_id = t1.item_id and t2.record_version_id = t1.record_version_id where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.process_id = #{processId} and t2.process_version = #{processVersion} and t2.product_plan_id = #{productPlanId} and t3.node_function != #{nodeFunction} GROUP BY t2.id ORDER BY procedureStepModelId asc

SELECT t1.process_id, t1.process_version, t1.id AS procedureStepModelId, t1.node_id AS procedureStepNodeId, t1.duration AS procedureStepDuration, t1.time_unit AS procedureStepTimeUnit, t2.id AS procedureModelId, t2.node_id AS procedureNodeId, t2.duration AS procedureDuration, t2.time_unit AS procedureTimeUnit, t1.procedure_step_id as procedureStepId, t2.`name` as procedureModelName, t1.node_function as nodeFunction, IFNULL(t1.sort,0) as sort, t2.procedure_id as procedureId FROM bm_procedure_step_model t1 LEFT JOIN bm_procedure_model t2 ON t1.procedure_model_id = t2.id
t1.is_deleted = '0' and t2.is_deleted = '0'
and t1.node_id in
#{nodeId}

SELECT t1.process_id, t1.process_version, t1.id AS procedureStepModelId, t1.node_id AS procedureStepNodeId, t1.duration AS procedureStepDuration, t1.time_unit AS procedureStepTimeUnit, t2.id AS procedureModelId, t2.node_id AS procedureNodeId, t2.duration AS procedureDuration, t2.time_unit AS procedureTimeUnit, t1.procedure_step_id as procedureStepId, t2.`name` as procedureModelName, t1.node_function as nodeFunction, IFNULL(t1.sort,0) as sort, t2.procedure_id as procedureId FROM bm_procedure_step_model t1 LEFT JOIN bm_procedure_model t2 ON t1.procedure_model_id = t2.id
t1.is_deleted = '0' and t2.is_deleted = '0'
and t1.id in
#{stepModeId}

select t1.*, t2.name as procedureName, t2.id as procedureModelId from bm_procedure_step_model t1 left join bm_procedure_model t2 on t1.procedure_model_id = t2.id
t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.is_deleted = 0 and t1.process_id = #{processId} and t1.process_version = #{processVersion}
and t2.name like concat('%', #{procedureName}, '%')
and t1.name like concat('%', #{procedureStepName}, '%')

select t1.name as recordName, t1.item_id as record_item_id, t1.file_content, t1.item_type, t1.page_config, t1.record_version_id, t2.procedure_step_id, t2.version as copy_version, t2.is_reuse as reuse, t2.is_discard as discard, t3.id as procedureStepModelId from bm_execute_record_copy t2 left join bm_procedure_step_model t3 on t3.process_id = #{processId} and t3.process_version = #{processVersion} and t3.is_deleted = 0 AND ((t2.is_reuse = false AND t3.procedure_step_id = t2.procedure_step_id) OR (t2.is_reuse = true AND t3.reusable = t2.is_reuse)) and t3.record_item_id = t2.record_item_id and t3.record_version_id = t2.record_version_id join bm_batch_record_item t1 on t2.record_item_id = t1.item_id and t2.record_version_id = t1.record_version_id where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.process_id = #{processId} and t2.process_version = #{processVersion} and t2.product_plan_id = #{productPlanId} and t3.node_function == #{nodeFunction} GROUP BY t2.id ORDER BY procedureStepModelId asc

select id as id, name as name, is_deleted as isDeleted from bm_procedure_step_model where id in
#{id}
